content_blocks.label: clause_1._Confidential_Information
content_blocks.text: ‘Confidential Information’ means all information disclosed by the Disclosing Party to the Receiving Party that is marked ‘Confidential’ or is identified as such in writing.

content_blocks.label: clause_2.1_Use_of_Confidential_Information
content_blocks.text: The Receiving Party agrees that it shall use the Confidential Information solely for the purposes set forth in this Agreement and shall not disclose it to any third party without the prior written consent of the Disclosing Party.

content_blocks.label: clause_3._Term
content_blocks.text: This Agreement shall remain in effect until the expiration of the term of the underlying agreement between the parties.

content_blocks.label: notary_note
content_blocks.text: Sworn before me this 22nd day of February 2024.
